description.value: COBS Bread is a Canadian franchise of the Australian Bakers Delight chain, with over 190 locations across Canada. This Abbotsford location at Gladwin Crossing bakes all bread and pastries fresh on-site daily with no freezing or refrigeration, and donates unsold goods to local charities at day's end. Touring cyclists can resupply with fresh bread, loaves, scones, bagels, and savoury items like mini pizzas.
